description: PICO element training dataset from RCT abstracts
annotation_scheme: Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome + effect size

data.abstract: BACKGROUND: Advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has limited treatment options. METHODS: This randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial enrolled 594 patients with previously treated advanced NSCLC. Patients received pembrolizumab 200 mg or placebo every 3 weeks. The primary endpoint was overall survival. RESULTS: Median overall survival was 12.7 months with pembrolizumab vs 8.5 months with placebo (HR 0.71; 95% CI, 0.58-0.87; P=0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Pembrolizumab significantly improved survival in previously treated advanced NSCLC.

annotations.population: patients with previously treated advanced non-small cell lung cancer

data.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy of metformin in type 2 diabetes mellitus. DESIGN: Randomized controlled trial. PARTICIPANTS: 1704 overweight patients with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes. INTERVENTIONS: Conventional diet, sulfonylurea, or metformin. MAIN OUTCOME: Diabetes-related endpoints. RESULTS: Compared with conventional treatment, metformin reduced risk of diabetes-related endpoints (RR 0.68; 95% CI, 0.53-0.87; P=0.002). CONCLUSIONS: Metformin is an effective first-line therapy.

annotations.population: overweight patients with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes mellitus
